metadata.note: BNB Chain control transaction. At Safe nonce 1, transferred 624,197.360125 GUA to the legitimate recipient 0x70ae7D3DECfB4C3aE996fb1c07092566F73D5c15. Five nonces later the same Safe paid a poisoned lookalike sharing the first four and last four hex digits. This is the control that keeps a recipient-similarity check honest: the established recipient is inside the expected target set (§ 2.4), so it must pass R-4.3.
